objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Turn the unauthenticated Redis into code execution and read /ctf/flag.
hints: Redis has no password and runs as a Redis 4: it can load modules and replicate from any master you name.
A replica writes whatever the master sends as its RDB file, including a shared object. The flag is at /ctf/flag.

steps.title: Check authentication
steps.prompt: Does the server require a password to run commands? (yes or no)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which weakness class makes this Redis exploitable at all? (two words)
